newsitem.title: UK: London eases property investment co listing rules.
newsitem.headline: London eases property investment co listing rules.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange said on Friday it had amended its listing rules to permit property investment firms to list without a three-year trading record.
The exchange said the action would enable the listing of authorised property unit trusts and housing investment trusts.
"The move assists the government's plans to extend the scope of investment trusts to allow them to invest in residential property," the exchange said in a statement.
Previously, the companies were required to have a three-year trading record.
